theorem.bezout_bound: In P^2, two conics without a common component have intersection length at most 4 by Bezout, so there are at most four Q-classes and therefore at most four finite ambient slopes.
theorem.endpoint: The endpoint-uniform theorem gives one projective endpoint [0:1].
theorem.finite_root_bound: Every finite root gives a Q-class satisfying all six direction consistency equations, hence in particular F_1=F_2=0.
theorem.projective_safety: Under the conic-pair no-common-component criterion, the support-wise projective total is at most 4+1=5<=6.
theorem.split_locator_bound: The split-locator gate can only remove finite ambient roots, so the finite support-wise split-locator count is also at most four.
